note: The built-in earlier American football seasons: every NFL season from 1960 to 2025, and the AFL's of 1960 to 1969 (`afl`). 1990 and 1992 to 1995 are the Tecmo Super Bowl games', 2001 (Madden NFL 2002) to 2025 (Madden NFL 26) Madden's launch rosters, and the seasons no game rated, 1960 to 1989, 1991 and 1996 to 2000 and the AFL's, are computed from Pro Football Archives' facts (`kind` pfa: npm run sync:pfa, scripts/data/pfa-seasons/<season>.json, its pages pinned in scripts/data/pfa-pages.json). A Madden season is its edition's NFL rosters at launch, from copies made at the time (EA's ratings services today serve rewritten launch iterations): npm run sync:madden-seasons reads the pinned sources (`sources`: copies kept in the gitignored data-src/madden-seasons/<season>/, each file by its SHA-256; `checks` are second sources it compares with) into scripts/data/madden-seasons/<season>.json. A Tecmo season (`kind` tecmo) is built from scripts/data/tecmo/<season>.json, which npm run sync:tecmo makes and pins (its overall is ours: docs/design/american-football.md). npm run build:nfl-seasons builds each season's clubs from those snapshots (a source's `id` names its data set, else madden-<season>), and npm run build:nfl-map each era's map from `teams` and `maps`. `teams` lists, by today's club (scripts/data/nfl-teams.json), the seasons in which a franchise played under another name or elsewhere: such an era keeps today's id, name, code and city unless it names its own; one that names a stadium replaces today's venue whole (a franchise that shares its stadium grows from its training base, `base`, as on today's map); one that is `absent` leaves the franchise out (before an expansion franchise's first season, and the Browns' three seasons without a club). A club plays where it played its home games that season (most of them, when it moved during one; the computed seasons' sync checks each against Pro Football Archives' scores, leaving out the Packers' games in Milwaukee). An era of the AFL's, before the 1970 merger, says so (`league` AFL): its club plays only in AFL seasons, on the AFL's maps. Stadiums the franchise research of 1980–2025 has no point for are placed from their Wikipedia articles. A stadium the club still plays in keeps its present name; one it has left is named as it was best known in those seasons. Washington's club before 2020 is named Washington: its name then was a slur the league has since retired.

remarks: Madden NFL 2002's roster has 31 teams (the Texans joined in 2002) and no Tom Brady, then New England's backup: true to the file.
Madden NFL 2004 leaves 45 players unnamed, listing them by position and number (C.#25): they are left out. Only the Chargers' CB C.#25 (72) would have started.
Madden NFL 2005 leaves 36 players unnamed, listing them by position and number (LG #65): they are left out.

The spreadsheets rate SS Ed Reed and P Shane Lechler 99, which maddenratings.net's own 99 Club note leaves out; no other copy of the launch roster survives to settle it, so the spreadsheets stand (a punter plays no part).
The Vikings' spreadsheet gives RT Phil Loadholt no overall (theedgepredictor's older copy of it has 66) and has an empty FB row: both are left out.

afl.note: The American Football League's ten seasons before the 1970 merger, computed as the NFL's of those years are (`kind` pfa, ids pfa-afl-<season>), each on an AFL map of its own: the AFL's clubs only, whose eras in `teams` carry `league` AFL. An NFL season never fields an AFL club, nor an AFL season an NFL one.
